title: Quercetin attenuates emamectin benzoate-induced myocardial PANoptosis in chickens: Critical role of the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and mitochondrial dynamics.
authors: Liu, Yong; He, Bai; Li, Li; Wang, Chunhua; Zhang, Liping; Mu, Qingchun; Cai, De
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素缓解农药诱导的鸡心肌细胞焦亡机制，涉及MAPK/NF-kB信号通路和线粒体动力学，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Emamectin benzoate (EMB) is a highly effective and widely detected environmental insecticide whose potential to induce severe cardiotoxicity and localized myocardial inflammation has raised substantial biomedical concerns. Quercetin (Que), a ubiquitous plant-derived natural antioxidant, has shown promise in mitigating exogenous chemical-induced toxicities, yet its precise immunopharmacological mechanism against EMB-induced cardiotoxicity remains to be fully elucidated. This study investigated the protective effects and mechanisms of Que. against EMB-induced cardiotoxicity by integrating network toxicology, transcriptomics, and in vivo/in vitro experimental validation. Multi-omics analysis identified MAPK8, MAPK3, and CASP3 as key responsive targets conserved across species. Functional enrichment revealed that these targets are predominantly involved in the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and mitochondrial organization. Molecular docking and targeted intervention experiments confirmed that Que. potentially targets and binds to JNK (encoded by MAPK8), thereby blocking the EMB-activated signaling axis. This molecular interaction effectively restored mitochondrial dynamics and prevented mitochondrial DNA leakage into the cytoplasm, ultimately alleviating myocardial PANoptosis. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that Que. serves as a natural antagonist against chemical-induced cardiotoxicity by modulating the MAPK/NF-kappaB axis, offering a promising therapeutic strategy for mitigating pesticide-related immunotoxicological risks.
abstract_zh: 甲氨基阿维菌素苯甲酸盐（Emamectin benzoate, EMB）是一种高效且广泛检出的环境杀虫剂，其诱发严重心脏毒性和局部心肌炎症的潜力已引起重大生物医学关注。槲皮素（Quercetin, Que）作为一种普遍存在的植物来源天然抗氧化剂，在缓解外源性化学物质诱导的毒性方面显示出潜力，但其对抗EMB诱导心脏毒性的精确免疫药理学机制仍有待全面阐明。本研究通过整合网络毒理学、转录组学以及体内/体外实验验证，探讨了Que对EMB诱导心脏毒性的保护作用及其机制。多组学分析鉴定出MAPK8、MAPK3和CASP3为跨物种保守的关键响应靶点。功能富集分析显示，这些靶点主要参与MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路和线粒体组织。分子对接和靶向干预实验证实，Que可能靶向并结合JNK（由MAPK8编码），从而阻断EMB激活的信号轴。这种分子相互作用有效恢复了线粒体动力学，并阻止线粒体DNA泄漏至细胞质，最终缓解心肌PANoptosis。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，Que通过调节MAPK/NF-kappaB轴，作为化学诱导心脏毒性的天然拮抗剂，为减轻农药相关免疫毒理学风险提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。
